title: Bounded below derived lower shriek of module objects
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and
let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes admitting a compactification. Let
$c=(X\xrightarrow{i}\bar X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ be the chosen compactification
of $f$ [def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek-compactification-plus]. The *bounded
below derived lower shriek*

$$
R^+f_!\colon D^+(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})\to D^+(\Mod_{\Lambda_Y})
$$

where $\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ and $\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}$ are the module-object
categories [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and $D^+$ denotes the bounded below derived
category [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], is the functor
$R^+f^c_!=R^+g_*\circ D^+(i_!)$ of
[def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek-compactification-plus] for the chosen
compactification $c$ of $f$.
